Name: Qi Qow
Author: yourboytoysteve
Description:
There's a strange new animal in Marnie's catalog. It's a...Qow? The Qi Qow is a new variant of cow. It will not replace any existing animals. It lives inside the Big Barn, and can be purchased after the player enters the casino for the first time. It can be milked for a kind of mystery box every three days.

[u]Qi Qow...stats?[/u]

[list]
[*]Cost: 1200
[*]Days to Mature: 5
[*]Days to Produce: every three days
[*]Produces: Mystery Boxes, with Deluxe Mystery boxes being unlocked with high enough friendship.
[*]Sunglasses: Yes
[/list]
[b]REQUIREMENTS:

This mod requires Content Patcher, as well as SMAPI. [/b]

[b]The UI Info suite mod is not required, but [i]heavily[/i] recommended in order to know when you can milk the Qow. Similar to the rabbit, it produces its product every few days, meaning that the actual week day is constantly changing.

[/b]How to install:

Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.
Unzip the file.
Add it to your mods folder.
